```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Obstáculos do Conglomerado com Um Estágio</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary-color: #2c3e50;
            --accent-color: #e74c3c;
            --bg-color: #f8f9fa;
            --card-bg: #ffffff;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--bg-color);
            color: var(--primary-color);
            margin: 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .container {
            width: 800px;
            max-width: 100%;
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
            padding: 40px;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            min-height: 500px;
        }

        h1 {
            font-size: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
            color: #34495e;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #eee;
            padding-bottom: 15px;
        }

        /* Container de Transição */
        .slides-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            height: 350px;
        }

        .slide {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(50px);
            transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .slide.active {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(0);
            pointer-events: all;
        }

        .slide.exiting {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-50px);
        }

        h2 {
            font-size: 40px;
            color: var(--primary-color);
        }

        p {
            font-size: 23px;
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: #555;
            padding: 0 20px;
        }

        /* Animações Obstáculo 1 */
        .anim-container-1 {
            position: relative;
            width: 270px;
            height: 200px;
            margin: 10px auto;
            border: 2px dashed #95a5a6;
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: #f1f2f6;
        }

        .dots {
            font-size: 70px;
            color: #7f8c8d;
        }

        .cross {
            position: absolute;
            font-size: 190px;
            color: var(--accent-color);
            font-weight: bold;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(3);
        }

        .slide.active .cross {
            animation: stamp 0.6s ease-in-out 0.5s forwards;
        }

        @keyframes stamp {
            0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(3); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(0.8); }
            100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
        }

        /* Animações Obstáculo 2 */
        .anim-container-2 {
            position: relative;
            width: 390px;
            height: 170px;
            margin: 30px auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-around;
        }

        .house {
            font-size: 80px;
            color: #3498db;
            position: relative;
        }

        .magnifier {
            position: absolute;
            font-size: 60px;
            top: 20px;
            left: 20px;
            opacity: 0;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .slide.active .magnifier {
            animation: scan 3s ease-in-out 0.5s infinite alternate;
        }

        .redundancy-line {
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 3px;
            background-color: var(--accent-color);
            top: 50%;
            left: 0;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .slide.active .redundancy-line {
            animation: fadeInOut 3s ease-in-out 0.5s infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes scan {
            0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0) scale(1); }
            50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(100px) scale(1.2); }
            100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(200px) scale(1); }
        }

        @keyframes fadeInOut {
            0% { opacity: 0; }
            50% { opacity: 1; }
            100% { opacity: 0; }
        }

        /* Botões */
        .controls {
            margin-top: 20px;
        }

        button {
            background-color: #3498db;
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 24px;
            font-size: 16px;
            border-radius: 25px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.2s;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        button:hover {
            background-color: #2980b9;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        button:active {
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="container">
        <div class="slides-wrapper">
            
            <!-- Obstáculo 1 -->
            <div id="slide1" class="slide active">
                <h2>Conglomerados grandes</h2>
                
                <div class="anim-container-1">
                    <div class="dots">🏢🏘️🏡</div>
                    <div class="cross">✗</div>
                </div>
                
                <p>Custoso medir milhares de unidades dentro de um único conglomerado.</p>
                
                <div class="controls">
                    <button onclick="nextSlide(1, 2)"> Próximo </button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Obstáculo 2 -->
            <div id="slide2" class="slide">
                <h2>Homogeneidade Interna</h2>
                
                <div class="anim-container-2">
                    <div class="redundancy-line"></div>
                    <div class="house">🏠</div>
                    <div class="house">🏠</div>
                    <div class="house">🏠</div>
                    <div class="magnifier">🔍</div>
                </div>
                
                <p>Elementos fisicamente próximos tendem a ser semelhantes.</p>
                
                <div class="controls">
                    <button onclick="nextSlide(2, 1)">⬅ Voltar ao Início</button>
                </div>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        function nextSlide(currentId, nextId) {
            const currentSlide = document.getElementById('slide' + currentId);
            const nextSlide = document.getElementById('slide' + nextId);

            // Adiciona classe para animar a saída do slide atual
            currentSlide.classList.remove('active');
            currentSlide.classList.add('exiting');

            // Aguarda um curto período para iniciar a entrada do próximo
            setTimeout(() => {
                currentSlide.classList.remove('exiting'); // Reseta o estado
                
                // Ativa o próximo slide (acionando também as animações CSS internas dele)
                nextSlide.classList.add('active');
            }, 300); // 300ms de delay para cruzar as animações suavemente
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
